texts.title: Parking Information
texts.content:
VISITOR PARKING
Levels 1 and 2 only
First hour free
Keep your ticket and pay at the machine near the elevator before returning to your car
Levels 3 and 4 are reserved for monthly permit holders
Vehicles without a permit on these levels will be towed

questions.stem: Where should a visitor pay for parking?
options: A. At the exit gate on Level 1
B. At the office on Level 3
C. At the permit desk on Level 4
D. At a machine near the elevator
questions.explanation: The sign says to "pay at the machine near the elevator before returning to your car."

questions.stem: What will most likely happen to a visitor who parks on Level 4?
options: A. The car may be removed.
B. The first hour will be free.
C. The visitor will receive a monthly permit.
D. The visitor will pay a lower rate.
questions.explanation: Levels 3 and 4 are for permit holders, and "Vehicles without a permit on these levels will be towed."
